title: Drive torque mismatch
description: Drive reports torque mismatch during motion.
likely_causes: Loose motor connector; driver overheated; encoder slip.
recovery_steps: 1) Stop AMR safely 2) Power cycle 60s 3) Inspect motor/driver connectors 4) Check encoder seating 5) Retry slow move test.
verification: Run 2m low-speed path; verify no alarms.
notes: If repeats, capture driver LED pattern.

title: Motor overcurrent trip
description: Drive current exceeded limit; controller cut output.
likely_causes: Wheel obstruction; seized bearing; cable short; aggressive accel settings.
recovery_steps: 1) E-Stop then clear 2) Inspect wheel path for obstruction 3) Check wheel rotation by hand 4) Power cycle 5) Retry with reduced speed.
notes: If physical resistance found, remove from service.

title: Driver comm reset
description: Transient comm reset between controller and drive.
recovery_steps: 1) Clear alarm 2) Reseat comm cable 3) Retry mission.
verification: No further comm resets in 10 min.

title: Localization confidence low
likely_causes: Dirty lidar cover; reflective surfaces; map mismatch.
recovery_steps: 1) Clean lidar window 2) Move to known landmark 3) Run relocalize routine 4) Retry mission.

title: Path planning blocked
description: Planner cannot find a valid path to goal.
likely_causes: Aisle blocked; forbidden zone too large; map stale.
recovery_steps: 1) Check aisle blockage 2) Move AMR to open area 3) Retry with alternate waypoint 4) Confirm map zones.
notes: If zone config issue, notify controls.

title: Odometry drift warning
description: Small drift detected but system compensated.
recovery_steps: 1) Acknowledge 2) Monitor for repeats 3) Schedule wheel inspection.

title: Battery undervoltage under load
likely_causes: Battery aging; poor contact; cold pack.
recovery_steps: 1) Dock and charge 10 min 2) Inspect battery latch 3) Retry reduced speed.
notes: If repeats, perform battery health check.

title: Charging handshake failed
likely_causes: Dirty charge contacts; charger offline; comm cable issue.
recovery_steps: 1) Clean charge contacts 2) Re-seat at dock 3) Reboot dock if allowed 4) Retry.
notes: If dock down, redirect to spare dock.

title: Charge session interrupted
recovery_steps: 1) Re-dock 2) Verify dock power LED 3) Retry.

title: Lift home not detected
likely_causes: Sensor blocked; cable loose; mechanical misalignment.
recovery_steps: 1) Clear obstruction 2) Inspect home sensor area 3) Power cycle 4) Run lift homing.
notes: If sensor damaged, remove from service.

title: Lift overload detected
recovery_steps: 1) Stop operation 2) Remove excess load 3) Re-align pallet 4) Retry lift.

title: Gripper open timeout
description: Gripper did not reach open state in time.
recovery_steps: 1) Check air supply 2) Cycle gripper 3) Retry.

title: Safety scanner blocked
description: Safety field obstructed or scanner reports blocked.
likely_causes: Tape on scanner; dust; object too close.
recovery_steps: 1) Remove obstruction 2) Clean scanner lens 3) Reset safety 4) Retry.
verification: Safety clears; AMR transitions to Ready.

title: E-Stop circuit open
recovery_steps: 1) Verify E-stop released 2) Check E-stop panel connector 3) Reset controller.

title: Safety acknowledgment required
recovery_steps: 1) Acknowledge on HMI 2) Resume mission.

title: Wi‑Fi roaming instability
description: Frequent AP roaming caused packet loss.
recovery_steps: 1) Move to stronger signal area 2) Retry mission 3) Note AP location.

title: Controller heartbeat lost
description: Fleet manager lost heartbeat to AMR.
likely_causes: AP down; switch issue; NIC fault.
recovery_steps: 1) Verify Wi‑Fi LED 2) Reboot comm module 3) Try fallback AP area.
verification: Heartbeat restored; AMR visible in fleet.

title: Telemetry delayed
recovery_steps: 1) Monitor 2) No action if mission ok.

title: Camera exposure out of range
recovery_steps: 1) Clean lens 2) Adjust lighting if allowed 3) Retry capture.

title: Barcode read failures high
recovery_steps: 1) Clean lens 2) Reduce glare 3) Retry with manual scan if available.

title: Motion controller watchdog reset
recovery_steps: 1) Clear alarms 2) Power cycle 60s 3) Retry mission.

title: Config checksum mismatch
recovery_steps: 1) Do not operate 2) Restore last known config 3) Reboot.

title: Task state conflict
description: Task state in fleet does not match AMR state.
recovery_steps: 1) Cancel task 2) Reassign 3) Restart client if allowed.

title: Repeated mission aborts
likely_causes: Downstream blockage; safety triggers; nav failure.
recovery_steps: 1) Review last abort reason 2) Clear environment issue 3) Retry with alternate route.
